Units: meters. Frame: x forward, y left, z up.
Mesh offsets are intentional. Do not center meshes independently.
Modification: removed lift and arm mounting links/joints; retained base/caster transforms unchanged.
This is CAD-derived geometry, not editable STEP. Inertias are supplied upstream and not validated here; contact physics is not configured.
